**Overall Assessment:**

The company shows slight improvement in several key areas between Q3 2013 and Q3 2014. While net income has decreased, several operating metrics point to positive underlying trends. The improved operational efficiency, coupled with slight growth in assets, contributes to a mildly positive outlook.
